pov_1.incident_summary: A grey sedan changed lane to the right and hit a motorcyclist; the impact is medium; the motorcyclist can wake up

units.text: Traffic accident — driver's duty to report; scene record
Red/Yellow/Green all dispatch an ambulance (assess; green may be non-transport)

do.text: Stop the vehicle and turn on hazard lights
Call 110 and report the location, time, and damage
Call 119; report a collision with possibly injured occupant(s)
If no one needs urgent care, visit a clinic yourself; re-call 119 if symptoms worsen

dont.text: Do not leave the scene before reporting

mechanism.text: Moderate mechanism — occupant conscious and moving, but injury possible; assess and observe for delayed symptoms

check.text: ABC + consciousness; severity impression on arrival
Advise self-presentation to a clinic; re-call 119 if symptoms worsen
Select destination by trauma grade; consult on-line MC if hospital selection is unclear
Record observation, urgency-assessment result, and explanation given

mmau_source.note: Path relative to the MM-AU CAP-DATA root (github.com/jeffreychou777/LOTVS-MM-AU). frame_range is the [start,end] frame-index window (inclusive-exclusive as extracted) this annotation/clip covers within that source video.
